title: Sliding Puzzle
summary: On a 2x3 board with tiles labeled 1 to 5 and an empty space marked by 0, a move involves swapping the empty space with an adjacent tile.
statement: On a 2x3 board with tiles labeled 1 to 5 and an empty space marked by 0, a move involves swapping the empty space with an adjacent tile. The board is considered solved when it matches [[1,2,3],[4,5,0]]. Determine the minimum number of moves needed to solve the board, or return -1 if solving is impossible.
constraints: board is two by three and contains each value zero through five exactly once.
A move swaps zero with an orthogonally adjacent tile.
Return the fewest moves to reach rows [1,2,3] and [4,5,0], or -1.
hints: Encode the six cells as an immutable tuple.
Breadth-first search tuple states; zero’s position determines its legal swap indices.
Return the layer where the target first appears.
Every edge is one move, so BFS first reaches each state by its shortest path and exhausts the reachable parity class before returning -1.
